eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

Adults aged 18 years or older Undergoing great saphenous vein endovenous laser ablation for symptomatic reflux Concurrent below-knee foam sclerotherapy

Exclusion Criteria:

Known thrombophilia Current oestrogen or hormone-replacement therapy Family history of venous thromboembolism or thrombophilia Active malignancy Prior ipsilateral ablation Deep venous reflux or obstruction
